note: Live band 8 downlink, 927.5 MHz. Physical cell identity 330 (N_ID_1 110, N_ID_2 0), normal cyclic prefix, 25 resource blocks -- a 4.5 MHz carrier -- and FOUR antenna ports, which is the only reason this file exists. Every other LTE cell reachable from this site transmits on two, so the four-port transmit-diversity path had never decoded a real signal and was wrong for as long as it existed: the second symbol of each Alamouti pair came out as -conj(x1), inverting one bit of every second symbol. A synthetic round trip passed throughout, because tests/lte_dsp_test.c's encoder transposed the same two terms. This capture is the check that convention cannot satisfy. It reproduces from a longer recording made the same morning; three megabytes is the size the frame-number check needs -- it wants more than eight consecutive steps before it will believe the counter is tracking, and two megabytes gave seven.
